• 🚫 Zerodha says it doesn't encourage excessive trading or use notifications designed to trigger trading activity

• 📚 Continues investing heavily in investor education through Zerodha Varsity and other initiatives

• 🛡️ Uses features such as nudges and Kill Switch to discourage excessive risk-taking and potentially harmful trading behaviour

• 🤝 Says the objective is to remain “human-centric instead of engagement-centric”, even if that potentially comes at the cost of revenue
